世紀經典 ; 01 | Shi ji jing dian ; 01

This book is a compilation of the essence of the ideas of Carnegie, the master of success, through the book covers interpersonal social interaction, family life, business negotiation, company management, emotional dialogue and other aspects of real cases, in-depth analysis of human psychology, teaching people to respect, understanding, sincerity as the cornerstone of the change in their attitudes toward the world, to improve their language and communication skills and enhance self-confidence, in order to obtain the trust of others and then influence others, and ultimately achieve success.
